caption: The drawing depicts a red, two-seat horse-drawn sleigh viewed from the side, with two beige, tufted, padded seats placed one behind the other. The body of the sleigh is constructed of smooth panels with subtle curves and contains interior lining that appears darker than the exterior red color. The sleigh is mounted on two long runners that curve upward at the front, supported by a framework of red struts and braces, all rendered in a matching color to the main body. The front of the sleigh features an ornate upward-curved prow. In the bottom right of the drawing, there is a separate smaller illustration showing a detailed view of the side panel, which includes a decorative white flourish. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color, and no other objects or scenery are present.
title: Two Seated Sleigh
